seo.title: Sharath Nair · Senior Frontend Engineer
seo.description: Senior frontend engineer in Hyderabad building fast, accessible React apps: server-rendered products, design systems and secure sign-in flows.

hero.headline: I build fast, accessible interfaces for the web.
hero.intro: I've spent {years}+ years shipping React apps that are fast, accessible and pleasantly boring to maintain. I take the work seriously. Myself, not so much.

paragraphs: I'm a frontend engineer in Hyderabad. For {years}+ years I've built React apps for enterprise and real-estate products: the parts people click on, and the parts that quietly keep them signed in and safe.
At TechMojo I lead the frontend of a tenant portal for our client ROSHN, in English and Arabic, so I now think in right-to-left. Before that I built ROSHN's design system and their public website.
These days I pair with AI agents a lot. They write code fast. I make sure it's code we'd still be happy to own next year.

items.label: Sitcom certified
items.text: Equal parts Chandler Bing and Michael Scott. Could I BE any more of a sitcom reference?

items.label: Traveller
items.text: Always planning the next trip. The itinerary is usually ready before the leave is approved.

items.label: Mountain person
items.text: Beaches are nice, but give me switchbacks, cold air and a view that took some climbing.

items.label: Biryani loyalist
items.text: Eternal love for Hyderabadi biryani. I have strong opinions on dum, and pulao is not biryani.

items.label: Gym regular
items.text: Most days start with a workout. It's the one sprint I never skip.

items.label: Sweet tooth
items.text: Huge one. Which, honestly, is half the reason the workouts exist.

items.label: Ambidextrous
items.text: Oh, and did I mention I'm ambidextrous? Either hand works, which is a handy party trick.

items.label: Chai addict
items.text: Kadak adrak chai, several cups a day. Challenge me to a chai-off and you will lose. Respectfully.

experience.title: Where I've been
experience.intro: Follow the line. It's been a fun ride so far.

projects.title: Side quests
projects.intro: Pass-time projects from the pre-AI era, when documentation was god and Stack Overflow was the closest thing to a copilot. They still work. Mostly.

writing.title: Writing
writing.intro: Notes on React and JavaScript, written back when I had free evenings.

contact.headline: Got a role, a project or just a good meme?
contact.body: My inbox is always open. I reply to every email, usually faster than I reply to the family group chat.
